name: fairy lights
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Fairy lights are a folkloric motif. Trooping fairies moved from one Otherworld dance hall to another. They walked in great ranks bearing torches above their heads. Since the fairy race is small, folk saw these parades as twinkling lights. The lights moved along invisible paths that never bent.

okr.objective: Fairy lights are the lights folk saw when the Trooping fairies went in procession.
key_results: Trooping fairies carried torches above their heads.
Their lights looked like twinkling points to human eyes.
The column moved along invisible but straight paths.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore
